name: Late Night Low Volume
author: Flubsound (Flubes & Claude)
description: For listening quietly without losing the music. Auto Level and a strong two-way compressor (quiet passages up, loud ones down, with 12 dB of make-up) hold tracks and sources at about -20 LUFS, from -14 LUFS masters to quiet -40 LUFS sources, and a fixed low-volume contour (+3 dB bass shelf with headroom protection, +1.5 dB treble shelf) offsets part of the ear's reduced sensitivity at low volume. The contour does not follow your volume setting.
